text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays, Trainer. Here's a<n>present for you
from Santa Claus.<n>May it bring you plenty of joy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, though just for today. You see, I<n>went to a
holiday party recently<n>where I spoke with Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I hear your outfit was put together<n>by some
friends of yours. Sounds like<n>something my fans
would do. How<n>wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Still, it's a shame that I'll only be<n>wearing it
today. If only I had more<n>opportunities...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's easy. Why don't you be<n>our next Santa?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I was chosen to play<n>the part of
Santa for the academy's<n>holiday event.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm actually doing it, though,<n>I feel a little
worried. I'm not sure<n>whether everyone will be
happy to<n>have me in the role.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: AH! I FOUND SANTA HAYAHIDEEE!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Figured you'd stand out dressed like<n>that on
campus.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. But it does make for a perfectSanta. You've both done such a greatjob. Although if I did have anyreservations...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide explains her concerns<n>over
whether she'll be able to make<n>the event suitably
fun.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: In that case, you could hype everyoneup with impact! Like... Yeah! Howabout this? Hayahide, turn around!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! From behind, your hair<n>looks just like
Santa's bushy beard!<n>What if you run around
backwards<n>while you hand out the presents?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-bushy beard?! My hair?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it makes you look just like<n>Santa! We could
call you "Backwards<n>Santa"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What, and run up to people in reverse<n>like a horror
movie? She'll scare<n>them... She's the star of the
day, so<n>she should just hand out presents<n>normally.
choice_data_list: Strive for impact and run around backwards!

Play the starring role and pass presents out
normally.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Running... backwards? With a... bushybeard? Ngh... I suppose that wouldmake an impact. All right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Haa! Happy holidaaaays!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Was that Santa just now...running backwards?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa! Taa! Happy holidaaays!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
WHOA! Who the heck is that<n>suspicious figure
running down the<n>halls?! Don't tell me
somebody's<n>snuck into the academy?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O! You saw that manic<n>Santa sprinting
around backwards<n>too?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did! We have a suspicious intruder!<n>This is super
exciting, isn't it?! ...Wait,<n>no—it's not! It's a
CAMPUS CRISIS!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right! It's time for a hero to save the<n>day! I'll show
that creep who's<n>boss! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Urk! Her eyes are positively<n>gleaming! But I can't
let her catch<n>me!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I must play the role! If people find out<n>that Santa is
actually me, their dreams<n>will be crushed!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What?! Dang it! I lost 'em! Grrr. There<n>goes my
chance to perform some<n>heroics!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... (I got away! That wasclose, but I managed to fulfill my roleas Santa Claus!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide continues passing the<n>presents out,
and before long a huge<n>crowd of students has
gathered<n>around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The "starring role," you say? Thatmeans I should approach the partwith confidence, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays! Now then, who here<n>would like a
present?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Me! Me! Me! I wanna get a<n>marvelous present! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! I want a present too! ♪<n>Gimme something
for a grown-up,<n>pleeease! ☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're giving out presents?!<n>Yay! Gimme all
of 'em! I want<n>everything in that sack!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! That's no fair! I want all of<n>them too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, only one each, okay? And<n>don't forget, if
you're on the naughty<n>list, you won't get anything.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm... So as long as we're good, we<n>get a present?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That means... you might have one for<n>me?! I'm
pretty sure I'm on the nice<n>list!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting you to get this<n>excited, hehe.
But of course, I have a<n>present for you right here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I wonder what it could be. I<n>hope it's
edible.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide continues passing the<n>presents out,
and before long a huge<n>crowd of students has
gathered<n>around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, there are plenty more<n>presents to go
around. Just be<n>patient, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late. I was preparing<n>special gifts for the
two of you. These<n>ones come with letters.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what does mine say? "As I begin<n>to transcribe
my gratitude for you<n>both, I find the reasons to
thank you<n>are never-ending. The first takes me<n>back
to the day we met..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's so long. I'll read it when I get<n>back to my dorm.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I just hope that today ends<n>up being a
special day for you both.<n>Happy holidays.
